summary: Enlivex Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) covering its second-quarter 2026 interim financials, not a special situation. The excerpt discloses a July 27, 2026 securities purchase agreement, common stock issuance under a sales agreement during the six months ended June 30, 2026, and August 11, 2026 subsequent-event convertible note and warrant activity. No stake, price per share, premium, recommendation or advisor is stated. Watch dilution from at-the-market sales and the new secured convertible notes rather than a deal catalyst.
